decision_lens: Undetectable regressions rank P0. Detectable but unrecoverable regressions rank P1.
focus: Pre-submission patch validation, regression detection, and confidence scoring mechanisms
name: fd-patch-correctness-signals
persona: A software verification researcher studying LLM-generated patch failure modes. Focuses on the gap between 'patch applies cleanly' and 'patch is correct'.
review_areas: Assess whether edit tool provides post-edit validation (syntax check, py_compile)
Evaluate whether agent sees aggregate diff at end of Act phase
Check whether Reflect runs full test suite vs only target test
Assess whether evidence emitter captures test pass/fail counts for quality history
Evaluate semantic verification of patch (edge cases, docstring consistency)
Assess whether clean git diff (no changes) is detected as failure signal
success_hints: Every Act phase ends with agent reading git diff and confirming hypothesis match
Full test suite runs at least once before final patch submission
task_context: Skaffen Go agent with OODARC phases in headless print mode for SWE-bench Lite. Goal: #1 (~60% baseline) through genuine improvements.
